name: look
description: Read what the person sees now: bench or lab mode, the bench snapshot (parts, wires, nets, findings, lesson), the lab snapshot when a lab is open (items, reports, mistakes, the experiment step), the selection, the co-build session and recent observations. Call it before answering about the bench.

name: list_targets
description: List what point_at can point at: lab item ids and kinds when a lab is open, else bench part refdes and pins as <refdes>.<pin>.

name: point_at
description: Show a callout bubble with a leader line from an item to a short text, such as 'use this one'. At most 3 at once; the oldest goes.

target.description: A lab item id or kind (bunsen-burner), a bench part refdes (R1, LED1) or a pin as <refdes>.<pin> (U1.D13).

text.description: A few words in the person's language.

tone.description: info (default), do (an action to take) or warn.

name: show_text
description: Show text in the speech bubble near the person, with optional reply chips the person can press.

name: propose_build
description: Start 'Build it with me': the co-builder proposes the first step of a template build as a ghost on the bench. Nothing changes until the person accepts. Only templates can be built today (for example Blink); a free request returns ok false.

request.description: What to build, in the person's words (help me build blink).

name: accept_step
description: Perform the proposed co-build step (the person said yes). Set all to do every remaining step.

name: reject_step
description: Skip the proposed co-build step for the rest of the session.

name: undo_step
description: Take back the co-builder's last performed step.

name: open_lab
description: Lay out a training lab on the bench (the circuit bench is hidden, never changed).

name: leave_lab
description: Leave the lab and bring back the circuit bench.

name: start_experiment
description: Start a guided experiment with its own kit. In exam mode the tutor is silent and hints and acting tools are refused.

name: set_lab_control
description: Work a lab item's control for the person (gas, light, collar, power ...), through the lab store so the tutor sees it. Refused in an exam.

action.description: One of the item's actions (look shows the kinds; bunsen-burner: gas, light, collar).

value.description: Optional value; numbers and true/false are converted.

name: request_item
description: Put equipment on the lab bench by kind or name. Equipment the lab has no model of comes as a labelled stand-in box (placeholder true): say so. Refused in an exam.

name: next_step_hint
description: The current experiment or lesson step and its hint, with a callout on the item it is about. Refused in an exam.
